maya (Product PM): Quick update — infra flagged a blocker on KV cache roll; the session-continuity streaming feature and prompt-archive indexing are both at risk for the current v1 window.

dennis (Eng Lead): Can you quantify the impact? how many days and which teams are blocked?

sasha (Eng-Platform): KV cache kernel patch needed. Rough estimate: 6 dev days + 3 infra validation days. Risk is regressions under long-tail seq lengths.

irene (Quality): If we ship streaming in degraded mode latency could increase ~20–30% on 8k+ requests. Would need regression tests and a small perf guardrail.

dennis (Eng Lead): Suggested trade: keep core API (generation, chat, embeddings) in v1. Defer streaming full-mode to v1.1. Also defer prompt-archive indexing (background job) to v1.2. Drop non-critical frontend polish. Quick sketch:

```
Keep: core API, embeddings, basic session tokens
Defer: full streaming (v1.1), prompt-archive indexing (v1.2), UI polish
Mitigations: degraded streaming (chunked flush), feature-flag rollouts, canary 5%
```

maya (Product PM): That sounds pragmatic. Tony — can we still hit the public launch date with that plan? what's the QA/canary timeline?

tony (Release Manager): We can keep the date if we lock the scope today. QA needs 5 biz days for regression + 3 days for canary monitoring. I can run a 5% canary with auto-rollback on error-rate > 1.2x baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: release/v1 scope-locked -> rollout 2024-03-28 09:00 UTC -> initial 5% hosts.

maya (Product PM): OK — I'll update the roadmap, post the scope lock to stakeholders and add the rollout cadence. Will follow up with a brief doc outlining the mitigations + test plan.

dennis (Eng Lead): :thumbsup:

sasha (Eng-Platform): I'll open the work items for the degraded streaming path and the kernel patch. tagging infra.

maya (Product PM): Thanks all. locking scope now. I'll DM any last-minute asks.
